name: 梦幻之间Nights黎明
lyrics:
[Instrumental Track]
No lyrics — pure ambient/soundtrack composition.
Mood: ethereal, dreamlike, contemplative.
Theme: the liminal space 之间 夜 and 黎明, fog over silent waters, anticipation of first 光芒

name: 电影感Before黎明
lyrics:
[主歌1]

In the hush before the morning 光芒,
Where shadows linger in the 夜,
A 低语 stirs the distant 天空,
The world holds still, no reason why.

[副歌]

Before the 黎明, the 寂静 breaks,
A promise that the morning makes,
穿过 every darkness, comes the spark,
A flicker glowing in the dark.

[主歌2]

The 星辰 fade slow, the 天空 turns gold,
A story waiting to be told,
Each frozen breath begins to thaw,
A path unshaped by what we saw.

[副歌]

Before the 黎明, the 寂静 breaks,
A promise that the morning makes,
穿过 every darkness, comes the spark,
A flicker glowing in the dark.

[桥段]

The first 光芒 rises, 轻柔 and shy,
It catches fire across the 天空,
And every soul that's dared to dream,
Will see it burn 穿过 every seam.

[Final Chorus]
Before the 黎明, the 寂静 breaks,
The world awakens, morning's awake,
No more the 夜 defines the way,
We rise with 光芒 to start the day.

name: 电影感Before黎明
lyrics:
[主歌1]

The 天空 holds its breath tonight
Waiting for the 光芒 to call
Shadows linger at the 边缘
Of every dream before it 降临

[副歌]

Before the 黎明, the world is still
Every heartbeat standing still
Before the 黎明, the colors rise
The first 光芒 painting open eyes

[主歌2]

星辰 retreat behind the hills
The 寂静 starts to fade away
A distant warmth begins to fill
The darkness turning into day

[副歌]

Before the 黎明, the world is still
Every heartbeat standing still
Before the 黎明, the colors rise
The first 光芒 崩裂 穿过 the 天空

[尾声]

And we rise with the morning 光芒
Into a world reborn tonight
